snippet.title: Turbo Outrun Reimagined: 4 vehicles + downloadable game
snippet.description:
Link to the game: https://sk1ds.itch.io/outrun-clone

My little game is starting to gain a bit of a fan base. Awesome! The biggest complaint though is the lack of prop variety.
Adding props was a big chore, but I've made some scripts to make my life quite a bit easier. So as you can see: I've reworked the first 4 stages, although the 3rd one can have a bit more variety. The 4th one doesn't have a lot of different props, since it's based on a Super Hang-On stage. Aside from the billboards, most of the stages only have one or two props.
In the future I'll rework all other stages and even add new sceneries, based on Outrun and Turbo Outrun.

Enjoy each stage with a different vehicle! The Countach is a bit damaged...
